items.exampleEn: Several birds are sitting on the roof.
The water level in the lake is very low this year.
Are you old enough to drive?
items.exampleZh: 你到可以開車的年紀了嗎？

items.exampleEn: Prices are going up at a fast rate.
This phone uses less power than my old one.
items.exampleZh: 這支手機比我的舊手機更省電。

items.exampleEn: Hundreds of people came to the concert.
items.exampleZh: 好幾百人來參加音樂會。

items.exampleEn: This old bridge is a thousand years old.
items.exampleZh: 這座古橋已經有一千年的歷史。

items.sentenceEn: It's nearly midnight. Let's go to bed.

items.audioEn: The ticket costs three hundred dollars for adults.

items.sentenceEn: I have been to Japan several times.
There are about a thousand books in our library.
items.sentenceZh: 我們圖書館大約有一千本書。

items.stemEn: This class is for students at a beginner ____.
items.stemZh: 這堂課是給初學程度的學生上的。

items.stemEn: I was so hungry that I ate the ____ cake by myself!
items.stemZh: 我餓到一個人吃掉了整個蛋糕！

items.passageEn: Our class wants to go on a trip to the mountains. We have a budget of five thousand dollars. The bus costs two thousand, and the hotel rate is one hundred dollars for each student. There are several things to do there, like hiking and swimming. The whole class is excited. We have nearly enough money now, but we need to spend less on food.
items.passageZh: 我們班想去山上旅行。我們的預算是五千元。遊覽車要兩千元，飯店的價格是每位學生一百元。那裡有好幾種活動可以做，像是健行和游泳。全班都很興奮。現在錢差不多夠了，不過我們得在吃的方面少花一點。

questions.questionZh: 這次旅行的預算是多少？
他們需要在哪方面少花錢？

items.promptZh: 今年我花在衣服上的錢比較少。
referenceEn: I spent less money on clothes this year.
This year, I spent less money on clothes.
rubricZh: 「比較少」用 less（不可數名詞前）
可寫例如 spent less money on…

items.instructionZh: 用 enough 造一個句子，說說你有沒有足夠的時間、錢或東西。
referenceEn: I don't have enough time to read.
We have enough food for the party.
rubricZh: enough 常放在名詞前（例如 enough time、enough food）
否定可寫例如 don't have enough…

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：we nearly have enough money 語序不自然，應為 we have nearly enough money；且 need to spend less on food, but... 的 but 轉折承接不順。
